name: COSMOSDataset
description: COSMOS Dataset (Combined Organic, Surface and Materials Open Source Dataset) aggregates 15 publicly available ab initio databases spanning molecules, inorganic crystals, metal and oxide surfaces, and metal-organic frameworks, covering levels of theory from generalized gradient approximation to hybrid functionals. It also includes a domain-bridging set, sampled from OC20, OC22, MatPES, ODAC23, OMol25, and QCML dataset and recomputed with MPtrj-consistent computational settings, which facilitates cross-domain knowledge transfer in a multi-task training framework. For detailed information about the dataset composition, see Table 1 from [the paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11241).
version: COSMOSDataset release as listed in Matbench Discovery at 8869a883a506
count_scope: Benchmark-reported242,788,218 configurations in the COSMOS training assembly; not a single deposited payload or deduplicated crystal population.
provenance: Fifteen pre-existing ab-initio datasets plus a new domain-bridging DFT layer; heterogeneous computational settings
license: CC-BY-4.0 declared for assembly/deposit; individual parent terms retained
